title: Restful Nights
description: Restful Nights makes sleep feel rewarding again.
body:
Restful Nights makes climbing into a bed feel like an actual reward.

It's a tiny, server-friendly quality-of-life mod for Minecraft 26.1.

## Features:

**Comfort Sleep** — your bed ignores nearby monsters. No more infuriating "you may not rest now, there are monsters nearby".  
**Full Belly** — a successful sleep restores your hunger and saturation. Set a trigger chance for randomness, or leave at 100% to always restore.  
**Well Rested** — after waking, you gain Speed I and Regeneration I for two minutes (duration and trigger chance both configurable). The waking player receives a private "You feel very well rested." chat message; nobody else on the server sees it.  
**Sleep Percentage** — set what fraction of online players must be asleep to skip the night. Default 50%, so 2 of 4 / 3 of 5 / 5 of 10 players asleep is enough. Vanilla behaviour (100%) and "one player skips" (0%) both supported.

## Configuration

Open Mods → Restful Nights → Config in-game, or edit **config/restfulnights-common.toml** in your world / server folder. Every feature can be disabled independently.

## Compatibility

No mixins, no asset overrides. Should be compatible with everything that doesn't directly conflict with wake-up mechanics.
